item.title: El-Sayed's "TrumpCare" Proposal, FBI Database Hack, Palisades Fire Guilty Verdict: AM Update 11/23 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Incoming Senator Abdul El-Sayed offers to rebrand Medicare for All as "TrumpCare" in hopes of winning President Trump's support, as the two sides signal a possible willingness to discuss healthcare reform. The FBI investigates an apparent breach of a critical national law enforcement database amid a series of cybersecurity incidents and widespread technology outages. Federal immigration authorities defend the arrest of a Mexican father and daughter at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport after videos of the confrontation spark criticism. A federal jury convicts Jonathan Rinderknecht of starting the blaze that became the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire, which killed 12 people and destroyed thousands of homes.
